title: Can the other room hide a closer point?
hook: Can the other room hide a closer point?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Cartesian coordinates, determinant sign, Euclidean distance.
doesNotKnow: Prune kd-tree nearest-neighbour branches only when their bounding-box distance exceeds the best point distance.

misconception: After descending to one kd-tree leaf all other branches can be skipped.
objective: Prune kd-tree nearest-neighbour branches only when their bounding-box distance exceeds the best point distance.

claims.text: A subtree box supplies a lower bound on every contained point distance. The traversal prunes only when that bound exceeds the best witnessed point, so a far side remains searchable when it could still improve.
